<details>
<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

This PR upgrades kubeadm cluster configuration patches from v1beta3 to v1beta4 across E2E setup functions and test cluster manifests. Changes include API version bumps, conversion of extraArgs from map format to name/value list format, and addition of consistent verbosity and aggregator routing settings.

## Changes

**kubeadm v1beta4 Configuration Updates**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**E2E setup script patch functions for DRA and WAS** <br> `hack/testing/e2e-common.sh`|`patch_kind_config_for_dra` and `patch_kind_config_for_was` define v1beta4 ClusterConfiguration patches with scheduler/controllerManager/apiServer verbosity (`v=3`), aggregator routing enabled, and feature gates (`resource.k8s.io/v1` for DRA; `scheduling.k8s.io/v1alpha3` for WAS), with v1beta3 fallback patches appended.|
|**Single-cluster test configurations** <br> `hack/testing/kind-cluster.yaml`, `hack/testing/kind-cluster-tas.yaml`|Control-plane, init, and join config patches upgraded to v1beta4 with extraArgs converted from map to name/value list format, setting kubelet, scheduler, controllerManager, and apiServer verbosity to `v=3` and enabling aggregator routing.|
|**Multi-cluster test configurations** <br> `hack/testing/multikueue/manager-cluster.kind.yaml`, `hack/testing/multikueue/worker-cluster.kind.yaml`|Manager and worker cluster control-plane, init, and join patches updated to v1beta4 with extraArgs reformatted to name/value lists, adding kubelet/scheduler/controller/apiServer verbosity (`v=3`), aggregator routing, and service account token settings.|

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes
